summary: Full E2E test of MBG Wireframe Studio. 20/20 backend tests pass (root metadata, wireframe spec, all/html literal route, 14 per-screen HTML routes, 404, Figma plugin zip, code.js node --check syntax validation). All frontend critical flows pass: app-shell loads, sidebar lists 14 screens, scope tabs filter (all=14, web=8, mobile=6), navigation updates topbar/canvas, all 4 topbar buttons present, download-plugin-btn triggers download of mbg-wireframe-plugin.zip, open-html-btn opens /api/wireframes/{id}/html in new tab with valid content.
critical_code_review_comments: wireframe_spec.py is ~650 lines and largely declarative data; acceptable but could be split into web_screens.py and mobile_screens.py for maintainability.

server.py uses os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*').split(',') which yields ['*'] OK; but with allow_credentials=True and allow_origins=['*'], browsers may reject credentialed requests. Not currently used (no cookies) but consider tightening for production.
All routes correctly ordered: /wireframes/all/html declared before /wireframes/{screen_id}/html — verified by tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_wireframe_api.py. All 14 screen IDs are parametrized. The literal /api/wireframes/all/html route MUST stay declared before the /{screen_id}/html parameterized route in server.py — moving it would break the all-html test. node is required on PATH for the code.js syntax test (already available).
